en.headline: Lam Tsuen spring fair stalls go to auction on 21 October
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department will offer 21 dry-goods and six wet-goods pitches for the 2027 fair in Tai Po.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department said on Wednesday that stalls at the 2027 Lam Tsuen Fong Ma Po spring fair in Tai Po will be auctioned in public on 21 October.

The fair is set to run for 15 days, from 6 to 20 February next year. Twenty-one dry-goods stalls and six wet-goods stalls will be offered. The department said the upset prices are 780 dollars for a dry-goods stall and 770 dollars for a wet-goods stall.

The auction starts at 2pm in the lecture hall on the second floor of the Lai Chi Kok Government Offices, at 19 Lai Wan Road, and continues until bidding ends. Anyone aged 18 or above who ordinarily lives in Hong Kong may bid, and a bidder may bid for more than one stall.

A successful bidder must pay the winning amount at once, register in person as the licensee, and sign the licence agreement on the spot, or lose the right to operate the stall. Licensees may put up stalls in the three days before the fair opens, from 3 to 5 February 2027. Enquiries can be made to the department's Tai Po office.

zh.headline: 林村放馬莆新春市場攤位10月21日競投
zh.dek: 食環署公布，2027年市場設21個乾貨及6個濕貨攤位，競投底價分別為780元及770元。
body: 食物環境衞生署星期三公布，2027年大埔林村放馬莆新春市場的攤位，將於10月21日公開競投。
市場明年2月6日至20日一連15天舉行，公開競投的攤位包括21個乾貨攤位及6個濕貨攤位。食環署表示，乾貨攤位競投底價為780元，濕貨攤位為770元。
競投當天下午2時在荔枝角荔灣道19號荔枝角政府合署2樓禮堂開始，直至結束為止。年滿18歲並通常居於香港的人士可以參加，亦可競投多於一個攤位。
投得攤位的人須即時繳付成功出價的款額，親自以自己名義登記為獲許可人，並即場簽署特許協議，否則會喪失經營該攤位的權利。市場開放前三日，即2027年2月3日至5日，供獲許可人搭建攤位。查詢可聯絡食環署大埔區環境衞生辦事處。
